tickets.body: Our API integration with the ERP has been failing since before Christmas and nobody has given us a clear answer. This is the second performance issue this year and it's taking too long to hear back.

tickets.subject: Exports still broken - going on two weeks
tickets.body: The export problem from December never actually went away, it just got quieter. Now it's back and worse. Twenty-five days to fix something like this is not acceptable for a Standard-tier account that pays on time.

tickets.subject: Escalating - report builder unusable since Monday
tickets.body: I need this escalated past first-line support. The report builder has been unusable since Monday and this is the third serious outage in seven months. We are reviewing whether Kataja can support our reporting cycle at all if this continues.

tickets.subject: Escalation - exports failing again, need a call
tickets.body: Adding to Liisa's escalation: exports are down too. We'd like a call with someone senior this week, not another ticket update. Our board pack is due Friday.

tickets.subject: Seat adjustment after the recent outages
tickets.body: Thank you to the team that got on the call last week - the fixes have held. Separately, could you adjust our seat count down by one, we had a role change.

tickets.subject: Dashboard performance - checking in
tickets.body: Dashboards have been fast and stable since the fixes went in. Small thing: could the currency default be set to EUR for all users rather than per-login?

tickets.subject: Report builder - quick question
tickets.body: Things have been running smoothly since the summer. Quick one - is there a way to duplicate a report template across workspaces?

tickets.subject: New dashboard widget request
tickets.body: Really pleased with how stable things have been the last month. Any chance of adding a rolling 12-month widget type to the dashboard builder?

tickets.subject: Export scheduling for year-end
tickets.body: Setting up our year-end export schedule - could you confirm the maximum file size for a single scheduled export? Want to plan ahead this time.

tickets.subject: Report builder - conditional formatting question
tickets.body: Is it possible to apply conditional formatting to a calculated column in the report builder, or only to raw data columns? Couldn't find it in the help docs.

tickets.subject: Dashboard filter not persisting
tickets.body: When I set a filter on the operations dashboard and log out, it resets by the next morning. Is that expected behaviour or a bug?

tickets.subject: Adding a second dashboard view
tickets.body: We'd like to set up a second dashboard view for the ops team with a narrower set of KPIs. Is that included in our current plan or does it need an add-on?

tickets.subject: Nested report sections
tickets.body: Trying to build a report with nested sub-reports by region and then by product line. Is that supported in the current report builder, or would we need separate reports stitched together?
